name: Purepuri Niizuma wa Boku no Tannin
original_name: プレプリ 新妻は僕の担任
source:
Enari Akane, a new teacher at your school, was recently married with you. She is a close friend of yours since you were kids. She is so curious about sex, wanting to explore sexuality more and more!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE025072.html]DLsite English[/url]]
